name: Hua Kang Health Center
website: none working - huakangskincare.com is a parked GoDaddy placeholder page
what_they_do: Massage and bodywork centre offering firm deep-tissue style massage aimed at knots and muscle tension, in private treatment rooms, with long daily hours. Review summaries mention named therapists (e.g. Nicole) and walk-in friendliness.
customers: Adults with neck/shoulder/back pain, post-pregnancy and sports-related complaints, plus walk-in relaxation clients in Milltown and nearby towns.

size_signals.signal: Multiple therapists named in reviews, private rooms, open 7 days roughly 10am-9pm (hours only on third-party listings)
40 reviews aggregated on BestProsInTown with ratings around 4.3-4.5

website_review.trust_signals: none online; only directory photos and review text
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The domain directories point to (huakangskincare.com) is a GoDaddy parked page reading 'parked free, courtesy of GoDaddy.com'
website_review.search_basics: No site to optimise: no title, description, service pages, hours or prices under the business's control; hours and services exist only as directory snippets
top_issues: No website and a parked domain advertised by directories
No service list or prices in readable text anywhere the business controls
No booking channel; walk-in and phone only

agent_readiness.notes: Nothing first-party exists: no site, no robots.txt, no schema, no hours in text. An AI assistant has to fall back on directory summaries, which disagree on hours. No online booking of any kind.

operations_signals.signal: Review summaries mention pressure to tip and an emphasis on cash - payment and tipping handled manually in the room
Open roughly 11 hours a day, seven days, with no online scheduling - every booking runs through the phone or the door
Mixed reviews about pressure intensity and upselling - an intake/preference step is missing

top_opportunities.opportunity: Basic site or single landing page with services, durations, prices, hours and click-to-call, replacing the parked domain
top_opportunities.evidence: huakangskincare.com resolves to a GoDaddy 'parked free' page; no other owned site found

top_opportunities.opportunity: Simple online booking/request with reminders for an 11-hour, 7-day schedule
top_opportunities.evidence: All scheduling is phone or walk-in; hours are long and continuous

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated intake (pressure preference, focus areas, tip/payment step) to reduce the complaints about intensity and tipping
top_opportunities.evidence: Review summaries cite very deep pressure and staff pressing for tips

scores.reasons: No website, no booking, no readable pricing - the largest possible gap; but this is a small cash-oriented massage shop with modest ticket sizes and no visible marketing spend; basic fixes are easy to deliver; evidence is thin because only third-party directories describe the business.
